newsitem.title: USA: Global Marine CEO comfortable with EPS views.
newsitem.headline: Global Marine CEO comfortable with EPS views.

text.p: Global Marine Inc Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Russell Luigs on Tuesday said he is comfortable with analysts' consensus earnings estimates of $0.25 a share in the first quarter 1997 and $1.35 a share for the year.

With its established fleet of offshore rigs, Global Marine is positioned to take full advantage of rising dayrates from surging worldwide exploration and production by companies racing to keep up with rising oil demand, he said.
"Very (comfortable)," Luigs said when asked whether or not he was comfortable with the estimates.
The company posted $0.65 a share earnings in 1996, nearly triple its earnings from a year earlier as rig availability tightened worldwide on demand by offshore oil and natural gas producers.
